name: Grind Wall
notes: Use: grindcore and powerviolence wall of noise. DIST maxed with LED clip for a harder, louder squash, RUETZ on and TIGHT 2 so blast-beat low end does not smear, FILTER fairly open for bite. High-gain amp (TONE3000 88689), V30-style cab (45023). Single path, no captures: renders from files in this repo only (the shared cab is the repo identity IR, a stand-in for a real cab). Rat-style op-amp distortion model (pedal.rat, VERMIN). Starting hypotheses, not a tuned tone.
